title: Pinworm tape test
what: A print is taken from the skin around the anus with sticky tape or a swab. It is checked under a microscope for eggs of pinworms, which are tiny worms.
why: For certificates for kindergarten, school, or a pool; or for itching around the anus at night, especially in children.
duration: 1 to 2 minutes; results usually come in 1 to 2 days
tell_doctor: If the skin around the anus is irritated or has sores

prepare.title: Morning
prepare.text: The sample is taken right after waking up, before using the toilet or washing. Pinworms lay their eggs at night.

prepare.title: Washing
prepare.text: In the morning, do not wash yourself or your child before the test. A normal shower the evening before is fine.

prepare.title: Kit
prepare.text: Get a kit from the lab: sticky tape on a glass slide, or a swab in a tube. Sometimes the sample is taken at the lab.

bring: The kit with the sample, or your child if the sample is taken at the lab
steps: In the morning, right after waking, spread the buttocks
Press the sticky side of the tape on the skin around the anus
Peel off the tape and stick it on the glass slide, as the lab showed you
If your kit has a swab, wipe the skin with it and put it in the tube
Wash your hands and take the sample to the lab the same day
feel: A child may feel ticklish or shy. Explain ahead of time that it is quick
after: Results usually come in 1 to 2 days
Sometimes the test is repeated 2 or 3 times. This is more accurate

faq.q: Why must the test be done in the morning?
faq.a: Pinworms lay eggs around the anus at night. In the morning, before washing, they are easiest to find.

faq.q: If pinworms are found, should the whole family be treated?
faq.a: Your doctor will decide. Often everyone who lives together is treated, and bedding is changed.

reminders.text: Pinworm test tomorrow. Do it in the morning right after waking, before the toilet or washing.
